name: manual_6125fb
claim: For idempotent clinebot CLI installation in install.sh/start.sh, compare installed version against npm registry via 'npm view <package> version' before installing; skip if versions match to avoid redundant fetches. Use 'command -v' guard before calling --version to prevent errors on missing binary, and fall back to the current install if the registry is unreachable.

decisions.notes: Discussed 2026-07-14: npm view is a lightweight registry metadata query (~50ms, no download). This pattern works for any npm-published CLI tool (clinebot, firecrawl-cli, etc.) and prevents redundant installs in CI/startup scripts.
